purpose: Deterministic UI evaluation tasks for the Polyorama component gallery and semantic snapshot contract.

dimensions.label: Visual and text contract
dimensions.one: Partially demonstrated; an assertion, required variant, or artefact is missing.
dimensions.two: All visual/text assertions pass with retained audit and visual evidence.

dimensions.label: Semantic contract
dimensions.one: Snapshot or parity evidence is incomplete.
dimensions.two: All required snapshot and AccessKit parity assertions pass.

dimensions.label: Interaction contract
dimensions.one: Only a subset of required pointer or keyboard paths is proven.
dimensions.two: Every listed interaction assertion is proven against the current semantic target.

dimensions.label: Verification evidence
dimensions.zero: Required command output or artefacts are absent.
dimensions.one: Checks ran but output is incomplete or not retained.
dimensions.two: Focused tests and all named machine-readable and visual artefacts are retained.

scoring.seed_aggregate: Arithmetic mean of normalised task scores.

visual_text: Visible focus ring is present and label is not clipped.
semantics: A button node has a stable action ID, complete name, enabled state, positive rect and no semantic parity mismatch.
interaction: Keyboard activation invokes the registered action.

visual_text: Tab labels use measured ellipsis with no text-audit finding.
Numeric widths are not derived from character counts.
semantics: Each visible tab has a complete semantic name, selected state and stable PaneId-derived ID.
interaction: Tab activation uses the selected whole target.

tasks.title: Narrow dock overflow and roving focus

visual_text: Only whole tab targets are shown; the explicit overflow target remains non-overlapping.
semantics: Overflow and visible tabs have stable names, roles, positive current geometry and no semantic audit finding.
interaction: Left, Right, Home, End, Enter and Space reach and activate hidden-overflow tabs.

visual_text: The visual divider and token minimum hit target remain distinguishable.
semantics: The splitter has a DockNodeId-derived ID, splitter role, current positive rect and adjust actions matching AccessKit.
interaction: Pointer drag and focused keyboard adjustment use the same 0.05 fraction command path.

visual_text: Persistent error text wraps within its declared line policy with no clipping or overlap audit finding.
Error colour remains readable in high contrast.
semantics: Status node retains complete error text and a valid rect.
interaction: No unavailable action is presented as enabled.

visual_text: Loading, empty, partial, error and selected states remain legible without overlap.
semantics: Snapshot contains only visible bounded cells and relevant domain references, not the logical collection.
interaction: Scroll interaction preserves a current semantic target for visible cells.
